# The Whole Wall

See ceramics, photographs and sketches together on one movable, zoomable wall — pin visual cards, drag them into clusters, draw “feeds into” links, and save different arrangements as named story orders. No due dates, streaks, timers or percentages.

## Run
Open `index.html` in a browser, or run `npx serve .` and open the URL shown. No build step, accounts, or network needed.

## Use
- **Add card:** `+ Add card` → take/upload a photo or scan, choose 🏺 Ceramics / 📷 Photography / ✏️ Illustration / 💡 Idea, write a required one-line note (max 140 chars), Pin to wall. Target: under 30 seconds.
- **Move:** Drag any card with mouse or finger; it stays where dropped, overlapping is allowed. Drag empty wall to pan.
- **Zoom:** Pinch, mouse wheel, `+`/`−` buttons, arrow keys in the wall, or **Zoom to fit** to see everything at once.
- **Edit:** Double-click / double-tap a card or tap Edit in Card Focus to change image, kind or note, or delete it (confirm + 10-second Undo).
- **Link:** Turn on **Link mode** (or a card's Link button), tap first then second card. A labelled line follows cards when dragged. In Link mode, tap a line to remove it.
- **Story orders:** Arrange the wall → **Save story order** → name it. In **Saved Orders** restore exactly, duplicate, or delete (confirm + undo).
- **Export / Import / Delete all:** Top bar. Export downloads JSON (including thumbnail images). Delete all asks for confirmation and offers undo.

Everything autosaves continuously, so you can pause and resume exactly where you left off.

## Data & privacy
Data is stored only on this device in `localStorage` under key `whole-wall-v1` (cards, thumbnail images as data URLs, positions, links, saved orders). Nothing is sent anywhere. To delete: use **Delete all**, or clear the site's storage in your browser settings. Export first if you want a copy.

## Manual acceptance tests
- [ ] Zoom out / Zoom to fit shows ceramics, photo and sketch cards on one screen with no page scrolling.
- [ ] Drag a card with mouse and with touch; it stays where dropped, with no snap to columns/lanes.
- [ ] Create a card with an uploaded image + note ≤140 chars in under 30 seconds.
- [ ] Link two cards; drag one — the line follows. Remove the line in Link mode.
- [ ] Save the wall with a custom name, move cards, restore from Saved Orders — positions match exactly. Duplicate the order.
- [ ] Confirm no due dates, streaks, timers or completion percentages appear anywhere.
- [ ] Delete a card/order and Undo within 10 seconds; Delete all and Undo.
- [ ] Export JSON, Delete all, Import the file — wall returns.
- [ ] Keyboard: Tab reaches all controls with visible focus; zoom buttons and wall arrow keys work; screen reader hears each card's kind + note and the live status messages.
- [ ] Reload the page — wall, links and orders are exactly as left.

# One Thing From Today's Walk

Turn one daily walk voice memo into one finished creative step. One memo per day, one concrete action under 15 minutes, then a calm "done" — no lists, no backlog, no deciding what to do next.

## How to run
- Easiest: open `index.html` in a browser (double-click it).
- Or serve it: `npx serve .` then open the URL shown.
- Works offline once loaded. Microphone and speech recognition need a secure context in some browsers — `npx serve .` (localhost) or https works best for recording.

## How to use
1. **Step 1 — Capture:** Tap the big **Record** button and talk/hum for up to 5 minutes. Tap again to stop. Words appear automatically underneath (Web Speech API where supported). No microphone? Type one short phrase in the optional box, or use **More options → memo file** to load an existing voice memo.
2. **Step 2 — Listen & check:** Tap **Play** — caption words highlight in time with the sound. Edit the words if recognition got something wrong, tap a memo-type chip (Melody / Line / Story / Idea), then **Confirm words**. Nothing is final until you confirm.
3. **Step 3 — One step:** You get exactly one physical action under 15 minutes (e.g. "Hum the chorus twice through, then re-record it once, slower."). Do it, then tap **Done** — or tap **Say "done"** and just say the word. A calm finished screen confirms you're done for today. **Different step** swaps in one alternative, still just one at a time.
- **Focus mode** (top right) hides everything except the current step. **More options** hides secondary actions (import, export, delete) so the main screen stays uncluttered. Past days are never listed — each morning starts empty.

## Where data is stored & how to delete it
- Today's audio blob, transcript, next-step text and done flag live only in this browser's **IndexedDB** (`one-thing-walk` database), keyed by today's date. Nothing is uploaded anywhere; there is no account or server.
- **Export:** More options → *Export today (JSON download)* saves today's words, step and done status as a JSON file.
- **Delete today:** More options → *Delete today's memo & words* removes today's audio and text from IndexedDB immediately.
- **Delete everything:** More options → *Delete all on-device data* clears the whole database and local storage.

## Acceptance tests to try by hand
- [ ] Open the app: only today's view, one big Record button, no lists, counts, menus or streaks.
- [ ] Record up to 5 minutes: timer and live level move, words appear without typing, recording auto-stops at 5:00.
- [ ] Stop, press Play on the same flow: audio plays and caption words highlight as it plays.
- [ ] Edit a wrong word, pick a chip, Confirm: exactly one physical step under 15 minutes appears.
- [ ] Tap Done: calm finished screen, no further tasks offered. Reload: done state persists for today.
- [ ] Try "Say done" instead of tapping (Chrome/Edge); on unsupported browsers, confirm the typed fallback message appears and buttons still work.
- [ ] Use the typed-phrase path with no microphone: phrase → confirm → step → done, with zero required typing elsewhere.
- [ ] More options → Export: a JSON file downloads with today's transcript and step.
- [ ] More options → Delete today: screen resets to empty Step 1; reload confirms it's gone.
- [ ] Come back (or change device date) tomorrow: empty fresh today, yesterday never shown.
- [ ] Toggle Focus mode: only the current step remains visible. Tab through with keyboard: every button has a visible focus outline and the "Step X of 3" indicator updates.
